Q0_explanation: Stock Ultralytics rebuilds the network from yolov8x.yaml at the start of train(), so a wrapper added beforehand is dropped unless the trainer is customised (your fork must patch this; attention_modules.make_attention_trainer does it here).
Q1_answer: trained together (fine-tuned end-to-end); only the fixed 16-weight DFL conv is frozen
how_attached: Module replacement, not a PyTorch forward hook: model.model[12] and model.model[15] (C2f blocks) are each replaced by AttentionLayerWrapper(layer, ResidualAttentionBlock(CBAM)). Forward = layer(x), then y + gamma*(CBAM(y) - y) with gamma initialised to 0 (identity at start).
note: Run on the reference re-implementation in revision/attention_modules.py, because your original ultralytics/nn/modules/cbam.py was not in the repository.
